why: An archive produced by an AGPL fork carries extra columns, a different economy config and unresolvable pack ids. An imported config must not raise this build's freeze cap.

cases.why: EC-PER-22: the fork's archive declares freezeCap 99. This build's cap is 2.
A cap of zero is honoured too: the clamp is to the build, not to a minimum.

unresolvablePackCase.why: A pack id this build has never heard of is refused, and the course it belongs to is kept rather than dropped (EC-PER-09).
